T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

{\*\generator Msftedit 5.41.21.2507;}\viewkind4\uc1\pard\nowidctlpar\sb120\sa120\lang1055\b\f0\fs28 MICROSOFT YAZILIM EK\'dd L\'ddSANS KO\'deULLARI\lang1033\f1\par
\pard\brdrb\brdrs\brdrw10\brsp20 \nowidctlpar\sb120\sa120\lang1055\f0\fs22 MICROSOFT WINDOWS \'dd\'deLET\'ddM S\'ddSTEMLER\'dd \'dd\'c7\'ddN MICROSOFT .NET FRAMEWORK 3.5\lang1033\f1  \b0\par
\pard\nowidctlpar\sb120\sa120\lang1055\f0\fs20 Microsoft Corporation (veya nerede ya\'fead\'fd\'f0\'fdn\'fdza ba\'f0l\'fd olarak yan kurulu\'felar\'fdndan biri) size bu ekin lisans\'fdn\'fd vermektedir.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Microsoft Windows i\'feletim sistemi yaz\'fdl\'fdm\'fdn\'fd (\ldblquote yaz\'fdl\'fdm\rdblquote ) kullanma lisans\'fdn\'fdz varsa bu eki kullanabilirsiniz.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Yaz\'fdl\'fdm i\'e7in lisans\'fdn\'fdz yoksa bu eki kullanamazs\'fdn\'fdz.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Bu eki, yaz\'fdl\'fdm\'fdn ge\'e7erli lisans\'fd olan her kopyas\'fdyla kullanabilirsiniz.\lang1033\f1\par
A\lang1055\f0\'fea\'f0\'fdda lisans ko\'feullar\'fdnda, bu ek i\'e7in ilave kullan\'fdm ko\'feullar\'fd a\'e7\'fdklanmaktad\'fdr.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Bu ko\'feullar ve yaz\'fdl\'fdm lisans\'fdn\'fdn ko\'feullar\'fd, eki kullan\'fdm\'fdn\'fdza da uygulanacakt\'fdr.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Bir \'e7eli\'feki olmas\'fd durumunda, bu ek lisans ko\'feullar\'fd uygulanacakt\'fdr.\lang1033\f1\par
\lang1055\b\f0 Eki kullanman\'fdz bu ko\'feullar\'fd kabul etti\'f0iniz anlam\'fdna gelir.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\f0 Bu ko\'feullar\'fd kabul etmiyorsan\'fdz, eki kullanmay\'fdn.\lang1033\b0\f1\par
\pard\brdrt\brdrs\brdrw10\brsp20 \nowidctlpar\sb120\sa120\lang1055\b\f0 Bu lisans ko\'feullar\'fdna uyman\'fdz ko\'feuluyla a\'fea\'f0\'fddaki haklara sahip olursunuz:\lang1033\f1\par
\pard 1. \lang1055\f0 EK \'dd\'c7\'ddN DESTEK H\'ddZMETLER\'dd.\lang1033\f1   \lang1055\b0\f0 Microsoft, bu yaz\'fdl\'fdm i\'e7in \cf1\lang1033\ul\f1{\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK "http://www.support.microsoft.com/common/international.aspx" }}{\fldrslt{www.support.microsoft.com/common/international.aspx}}}\cf0\lang1055\ulnone\f0\fs20  sayfas\'fdnda a\'e7\'fdklanan destek hizmetlerini sa\'f0lamaktad\'fdr\lang1033\f1 .\b\par
\lang1043 2. \lang1055\f0 MICROSOFT .NET G\'dc\'c7 \'d6L\'c7\'dcM TEST\'dd.\lang1043\f1  \lang1055\f0 Yaz\'fdl\'fdm, Windows i\'feletim sistemlerinin .NET Framework, Windows Communication Foundation, Windows Presentation Foundation ve Windows Workflow Foundation bile\'feenlerini (.NET Bile\'feenleri) i\'e7ermektedir.\lang1043\f1   \lang1055\f0 .NET Bile\'feenlerine kendi b\'fcnyenizde g\'fc\'e7 \'f6l\'e7\'fcm testi yapabilirsiniz.\lang1033\f1  \lang1055\f0 .NET Bile\'feenlerine yap\'fdlan herhangi bir g\'fc\'e7 \'f6l\'e7\'fcm testinin sonu\'e7lar\'fdn\'fd\lang1033\b0\f1  \cf2\b{\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK "http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406&clcid=0x409" \\\\\\\\o "http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406&clcid=0x409" }}{\fldrslt{\cf1\ul\b0 http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406}}}\cf0\ulnone\f1\fs20  \lang1055\b\f0 adresinde belirtilen \'feartlara uyman\'fdz kayd\'fdyla a\'e7\'fd\lang1033\f1 klayabilirsiniz.\b0\par
\lang1055\f0 Microsoft ile yapm\'fd\'fe olabilece\'f0iniz ba\'feka herhangi bir s\'f6zle\'femeye kar\'fe\'fdn, bu t\'fcrden bir g\'fc\'e7 \'f6l\'e7\'fcm testinin sonu\'e7lar\'fdn\'fd a\'e7\'fdklaman\'fdz halinde Microsoft, \cf2\lang1033\f1{\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK "http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406&clcid=0x409" \\\\\\\\o "http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406&clcid=0x409" }}{\fldrslt{\cf1\ul http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=66406}}}\cf0\lang1055\ulnone\f0\fs20  adresinde belirtilen \'feartlara uymak kayd\'fdyla, sizin ilgili .NET Bile\'feenine rakip olan \'fcr\'fcnlerinize uygulad\'fd\'f0\'fd g\'fc\'e7 \'f6l\'e7\'fcm testlerinin sonu\'e7lar\'fdn\'fd
